item.title: All roads of Bogue Chitto Wildlife Management Area closed due to flooding
item.description: FRANKLINTON &mdash; The Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries has closed all roads on the Bogue Chitto Wildlife Management Area due to flooding.&nbsp;The Department said Tuesday that the roads will reopen once the water recedes.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Judge denies early release for man convicted of killing 7 in drunk driving crash
item.description: CLINTON &mdash; An East Feliciana judge denied an early release for a man who killed seven people in a 2012 drunk driving crash.Brett Gerald pleaded guilty to seven counts of vehicular homicide after he drunkenly drove on La. 67 in Slaughter, causing a head-on collision that killed a family of six and their friend.
